#Text=Since Firefox 74, it's consuming a large about of memory and never release it on MacOS.
#Text=With my usual browsing experience, before 74, I never had to restart Firefox because of its memory impact, but now I need to.
#Text=As usual, with memory based report, there are so many factor that could cause this, it's hard to reproduce, so I simplified the test to the most simple case I could do, that is:
#Text=1. Started as safe mode without any extension
#Text=2. Loaded a bunch of tabs (my previous browsing session)
#Text=4. Set the computer to sleep during the night by closing lid
#Text=6. Saved memory report, memory increased by a lot
#Text=The memory increased by at least 300MB from the process manager.
#Text=The memory should more or less stay the same while time goes on.
#Text=Please notice that I've tried to minimize the memory usage (in about:memory) but it's useless ?
#Text=I found when the scanner does not closed successfully, it remains forever in the hashMap that stores the state of the scanner.
#Text=To resolve this problem, I make scannerMap to Guava Cache so that can be expired on set time.

#Text=3. Freezes due to a huge memory leak
#Text=When I click on emails the whole client will freeze and then crash.
#Text=I should be able to check my emails without having to reopen Thunderbird multiple times just to get through the emails.
#Text=I have resorted to checking email on the web due to this issue.
